description: Every tool ProdForge knows how to wire together. One catalog, no hunting.

tools.name: greenlight
tools.purpose: Contribution pre-flight: is this issue/repo safe and clear to build on?

tools.name: prwatch
tools.purpose: PR attention triage: which PRs need you, ranked with evidence.

tools.name: claimcheck
tools.purpose: Stale-claim and parked-fix states for issues and forks.

tools.name: gatefile
tools.purpose: Extracts contribution gates into a checkable gates file, validates CI drift.

tools.name: shipcheck
tools.purpose: Release truth: tag, GitHub release, npm, MCP Registry and GHCR all agree, or NO-GO.

tools.name: cidiff
tools.purpose: Base vs head CI differ: which failures did this change actually introduce?

tools.name: reprocheck
tools.purpose: Red-first repro verifier: fails on base, passes on fix, honest delta.

tools.name: hookcheck
tools.purpose: Git hook and pre-commit safety checks.

tools.name: actionpin
tools.purpose: Pins GitHub Actions to SHAs, reports unpinned and outdated actions.

tools.name: injectcheck
tools.purpose: Prompt-injection surface checks for agent-facing code and content.

tools.name: mcpvet
tools.purpose: Vets MCP servers: fingerprints, probe parity, derived risk score.

tools.name: depguard
tools.purpose: Dependency guard: risky, abandoned, or surprising deps flagged with evidence.

tools.name: flowcheck
tools.purpose: Workflow validator: timeouts, permissions, concurrency guards.

tools.name: tracewatch
tools.purpose: Agent trace watching and anomaly surfacing, local-first.

tools.name: wallcheck
tools.purpose: Bot-wall and exposure probe: OPEN / CHALLENGED / WALLED, plus served-page exposure classes.

tools.name: mcpaudit
tools.purpose: Audits any MCP server: handshake, tool schemas, descriptions, error handling.

tools.name: contextbudget
tools.purpose: Token budget per file and directory for agents: what is eating the window.

tools.name: agentsfile
tools.purpose: Generates and validates AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md from repo reality.

tools.name: envdoc
tools.purpose: .env.example generated and verified from actual env usage in code.

tools.name: npmpreflight
tools.purpose: npm pack auditor: files shipped, size, secret-pattern leak scan, missing fields.

tools.name: envdoctor
tools.purpose: Local env doctor: node, git, ports, env, required services, pass/fail with fixes.

tools.name: logdigest
tools.purpose: Condenses long CI logs to the failure section and root-cause lines.

tools.name: commitcheck
tools.purpose: Commit message vs repo convention plus DCO sign-off checker.

tools.name: inboxwatch
tools.purpose: Inbox watching for replies that change the plan, local and deterministic.

tools.name: pkgverdict
tools.purpose: Package verdict: should you depend on this package? Evidence, not vibes.

tools.name: prodforge
tools.purpose: This repo: connects all of the above into one production path.
